renewal.title: Accessory renewal work items
renewal.subject: Service number
renewal.guidance: Snapshots and backups awaiting payment are retained, with restore and other usage paused. After payment, check the resource status and whether restore is available. Pending invoice closures require confirmation. Process invoices using your existing invoice permissions.
renewal.syncFailed: Renewal reminders could not be updated. The count may be out of date. Refresh to try again.
renewal.listFailed: Renewal work items could not be loaded. Refresh to try again, or contact an administrator if this continues.
